answer: VDF timing proofs: each identity must post a sequential-delay output (10^9 squarings, ~60s, non-parallelizable). Enrollment rate caps at one identity per core per minute. A 10k-identity farm burns 10k core-hours plus ASIC cost; honest nodes clear the plume of stale proofs. Cedar audits timestamps — forged proofs fail. The voyage from one identity to 10k costs ~$40k electricity, exceeding reward. Works because delay is provably unshortcuttable.
